pages.text: A Pouch adds $(thing)98 storage capacity$() when equipped in a Hip slot. Three Hip slots are available by default. Three Pouches add 294 capacity, and you can mix Pouches and Bags in those slots.
Use seven leather and one iron nugget around a wool block. The wool sets the pouch color.
Combine a Pouch with any dye to change its color. Every color has the same capacity.

pages.title: All 16 Colors
pages.text: White, Orange, Magenta, Light Blue, Yellow, Lime, Pink, Gray, Light Gray, Cyan, Purple, Blue, Brown, Green, Red, and Black.
